versions.content: If the number of negative responses for a requested diagnostic tasks (see [SWS_Dcm_00024]) reaches the value defined in the configuration param- eter DcmDslDiagRespMaxNumRespPend , the Dcm module shall stop processing the active diagnostic request, inform the application or BSW (if this diagnostic task implies the call to a SW-C interface or a BSW interface) by setting OpStatus parameter, of active port interface, to DCM_CANCEL , report the runtime error DCM_E_INTERFACE_- TIMEOUT and shall send a negative response with NRC 0x10 (General reject).
